programme.title: Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani
programme.desc: Prem, a free-spirited boy, falls in love with a young girl Jenny. However, when he learns that she is in love with her college sweetheart, Rahul, Prem sacrifices his love and helps Jenny to get married to the love of her life.

programme.title: Saath Saath
programme.desc: Avinash, working a day job at his friend's publishing house, does not believe in chasing riches. But when his wife gets pregnant, the financial crunches start to drift Avinash away from his values.

programme.title: Sharafat Gayi Tel Lene
programme.desc: A geeky commoner Prithvi Khurana (Zayed Khan) is content with his mediocre job and steady girlfriend. But when his account mysteriously gets credited with 1 million rupees he seeks the help of his philandering slacker roommate Sam (Rannvijay Singh) to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Soldier
programme.desc: Army Major Vijay Malhotra gets murdered by the mafia and is falsely declared a traitor by his corrupt colleagues. To avenge his death and clear his name, his son Vicky grows up to be a soldier and vows to set things right at any cost.

programme.title: Aankhen
programme.desc: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. To make the robbery untraceable, he trains three blind men to do the job for him.

programme.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programme.desc: Sameer, a hot-tempered guy relocates to Goa, where he falls in love with Rani. However, his new roommate Sunny puts a spoke in the wheel upon his arrival and Rani finds herself in a dilemma as she starts liking both Sameer and Sunny.
